classes.wired: statically reachable from an entry point, the ability catalog, or hive_tools/self_data
classes.wired_dynamic: loaded by name at runtime (organs loader create_organ; .github/agents script_path)

classes.shim: compat re-export of a canonical module; nothing to wire
classes.helper: imported only by unwired code; follows its parent
classes.wire: intended feature, not wired yet (next batch)
classes.dry_run: side-effecting feature; wire only as dry-run/report (not done here)
classes.standalone: hand-run CLI / maintenance / example script; not a product surface
classes.superseded: older twin/variant of a canonical module
classes.dead: vendored third-party, placeholder, learned stub, or non-Python
